title: The Columnar Transposition
description:
Evidence Folder #7 contained a 3-column transposition cipher.
Columns read: Col 1: 'TSN', Col 2: 'HIO', Col 3: 'EEN'.
question: Reconstruct row-by-row (Row 1: T-H-E, Row 2: S-I-G, Row 3: N):
acceptable_answer_format:
Type the decoded phrase.

Example:
THE SIGN
hints: Read characters across rows from Column 1, Column 2, Column 3.
Row 2: S I G -> SIG... Row 3: N.
solution_explanation: Reading row by row across the 3 columns (Row 1: T-H-E, Row 2: S-I-G, Row 3: N) produces 'THE SIGN'.
